title: Custom eggless anniversary cakes for Auburn and Harris Park couples
summary:
Custom eggless anniversary cakes for Auburn and Harris Park couples. 100% eggless, made to your design.

Your parents' 30th. Your first year. Whichever it is, the cake should not be the thing you worry about on the night. Many Auburn and Parramatta households have a guest who cannot eat egg, and a shop-bought cake rarely says so on the label. Ours is eggless every time, with no exceptions, which is why you never have to ask.

Pick a size from 6 inch ($39.99, serves 6 to 8) to 16 inch, choose from 15 flavours, and send us a photo of the design you want. Order two days ahead. Collect from Shop 1, 96-98 Wigram Street, Harris Park, open 11am to 10pm daily, so a dinner-time pickup works.

Tap Learn more to start your order.
